description: Call this when the user asks which indicators currently sit in an unusual band, whether a metric's current level historically preceded BTC moves, or for a cross-metric conditional overview. Returns every recorded metric in its historical band with the median 7-day BTC move that followed versus the base rate, with an n >= 30 gate; distributions, not forecasts.
name: get_factor_board
title: Factor board: what followed days like today across recorded metrics
